effectSummary.ko: 거인의 심판으로 직접 맞힌 적마다 최대 HP 3%, 최대 15% 보호막을 4초간 얻습니다.
effectSummary.en: Each enemy directly hit by Titan's Judgment grants a 4s barrier of 3% maximum HP, capped at 15%.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone HELLSCRIPT passive skill icon, matching painterly dark gothic fantasy game icons. Generate one original square PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. One isolated symbolic subject. Worn iron, aged leather, restrained sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, strong distinctive readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Entire subject including effects inside the central 72 percent, leave clear fully transparent margins. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, frame, medallion rim, panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, matte, or tiny particles. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Output a transparent PNG. Identity (do not render text): Warrior passive Titan's Bulwark, 거인의 보루. Effect: Titan's Judgment creates a short-lived barrier for each enemy hit. Subject: a single massive weathered iron gauntlet gripping a heavy hammer pommel, enclosed by three joined thick angular amber shield plates. A quiet protective emblem of a titan's enduring strength, not an attack scene; rust-red leather, dull steel, restrained golden edge light. Keep the three plate shapes broad and connected, with spacious transparent cutouts.

visualReview.en: The hammer gauntlet and amber shield plates remain distinct from the ancestor mask.
visualReview.ko: 망치를 쥔 철제 건틀릿과 황금빛 보호판이 선조 가면과 구별됩니다.

edgeReview.en: Inspected native image and 64px light/dark composites: no visible opaque matte, clipped core, or edge halo. Native pixels unchanged; low-alpha fringe warnings retained.
edgeReview.ko: 원본과 64px 밝은 배경·어두운 배경 비교에서 주요 형태의 잘림, 불투명 바탕, 눈에 띄는 테두리 번짐이 없습니다. 원본 픽셀은 변경하지 않았으며 낮은 알파 경계 경고는 보존했습니다.
